root_idea.summary: The root centers on diminution: making something less, deficient, or incomplete, especially diminishing what is due to someone.
root_idea.development: The lexical record presents diminution both as a thing becoming less and as the withholding of a person's due; it also preserves separate branches involving restraint or turning away and oath-related vocabulary.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form أَلَتَ.

senses.definition: To diminish for someone what is due to them, abridging or depriving them of a portion; in the Quranic usage, to withhold nothing of the reward of their work.
senses.usage_conditions: Transitive with a person and their due, right, property, or reward; the Quranic construction uses مِنْ to express what is not withheld from their deeds or reward.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To decrease, diminish, or become deficient, incomplete, or imperfect.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive use describing a thing that becomes less or defective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withhold or restrain someone and turn or avert them from their course, purpose, or object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with a person, optionally with عَنْ and the course, purpose, or object from which they are turned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone swear, ask them to swear or give testimony, or press them with an oath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in oath-taking and adjuration constructions, including pressing someone with an oath.
A nominal expression for the absence of a sufficient amount or provision.
A noun used for oath-taking or an oath used to bind someone to give what is due.
A nominal use for defamatory or falsely accusatory speech.
A nominal expression for a gift of small value or size.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An oath of the type called غَمُوس.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use for an oath classified as غَمُوس.
